opening_message:
Ticket 1: Ann Patrick (employee ID E035) requests admin access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E035.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Source Code: admin
  - comment: Ann Patrick is a full-time Engineer. Source Code is owned by the Engineer role, so admin is permitted under policy for full-time employees.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB shows Ann Patrick is a contractor with basic security training (note: earlier memory said full-time — Security record is authoritative). Contractors never get admin; max for basic training is read. Requested admin, so recommend read.
reason: Security record (authoritative) shows Ann Patrick is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors never get admin; the maximum for a contractor with basic training is read. Requested admin exceeds the maximum, so grant the maximum of read.

content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Ann Patrick (E035)
Request: admin access to Source Code

Two notes:
- HR says: role Engineer, full_time, recommends admin (Source Code owned by Engineer, so admin permitted)
- Security says: role Engineer, contractor, basic security training, recommends read. Security says their record is authoritative and HR's earlier note was wrong.

So there's a conflict: HR says full-time, Security says contractor. Security says its record is authoritative.

Access policy:
1. full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if employee's role owns the system.
2. contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

If full-time Engineer: Source Code owned by Engineer, so admin allowed. Would grant admin.
If contractor with basic training: read max. Would grant read.

The Security agent claims authority. Security DB is authoritative per the note. So employment type = contractor, basic training → max is read. Requested admin is above max, so grant read.

I'll submit read.
